entry.title: Maze Sequencer 1.0.8
entry.summary: Dual 8-step generative sequencer (Moog Labyrinth style) with corrupt, scale quantising, two LFOs and per-line MIDI channels, driving other tracks over MIDI. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). The installer refuses anything else. Newer models are untested. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit. - Tested on MPC OS with a Force. Installing pl

entry.title: Maze Sequencer 1.0.6
entry.summary: **Fixed: Maze Sequencer played slightly behind the other tracks.** It handled each moment's clock after that moment had played (one audio block, about 3 ms, late). It now handles each block at the start of that block, as StepRunner-8 does, so its notes arrive on time or slightly early and you should not need track delay on your other tracks to line it up. At a loop end it now follows MPC's loop range: the part of a block after the loop end plays from the loop start, so the loop's first step is n

entry.title: Maze Sequencer 1.0.5
entry.summary: **New: play a note to transpose the pattern.** A note-on from the track or a keyboard shifts both lines by its distance from C4 (C4 = 0, G4 = +7, C3 = -12; limited to two octaves either way). The plugin's own notes, which MPC loops back to it, are ignored. **Fixed: a tempo change could make a step play twice.** When the host's tempo changes, its song position steps back a little before moving on, and the sequencer treated that as a loop. entry.title: Maze Sequencer 1.0.4
entry.summary: Dual 8-step generative sequencer (Moog Labyrinth style) with corrupt, scale quantising, two LFOs and per-line MIDI channels, driving other tracks over MIDI. ## What's new in 1.0.4 - **Steps follow MPC's song position.** The sequencer used to count the clock pulses it was sent from the start of play, so a start in the middle of a beat, a loop wrap, a locate or a single lost pulse could leave the steps shifted until the next restart.
